    Established in 1991, MICA is an autonomous, non-profit institution dedicated to creating leadership in Management. MICA offers a wide range of academic programmes, which include the Post Graduate Diploma in Management -Communications (PGDM-C) , Post Graduate Diploma in Management (PGDM) , Post Graduate Certificate in Management in Advertising and Marketing Communication (PGCM – AMC), (Earlier CCC), Post Graduate Certificate in Management in Digital Media and Marketing Communications (PGCM-DMMC), (Earlier CCE) and Fellow Programme in Management (FPM). This apart, MICA also conducts a host of Online Programmes, Leadership and Management Development Programmes (LMDPs), and Training Programmes and Workshops.

    A ‘Different School of Thought’

    Since its inception, MICA has fostered students' creative, analytical and management skills and help prepare them for leadership positions in corporates and organisations besides tapping into their entrepreneurial mindsets. Today, it is the alma mater of professionals serving in leadership positions in some of the best-known global companies in sectors as diverse as FMCGs and Consumer Durables, IT and ITES, Consulting, Banking & Financial Services, e-Commerce Platforms, Digital Natives, Start-Up Unicorns, Media & Advertising, Market Research and Analytics, to name a few. The MICA brand assures effective delivery of Strategic Marketing and Communication solutions to the industry, government, and community. 4394-

    Excellence in Strategic Marketing & Communication

    MICA is also an excellence hub for academic research in Strategic Marketing and Communication. Our faculty creates and expands the boundaries of both theory and methodology in these fields. Our research is published in the world's leading journals on Marketing, Consumer Behaviour, Communication and Management while other academics routinely cite our papers. Our faculty are eminent authors with their contributions published in academic handbooks and books. Our faculty is frequently called upon to consult industry to solve complex business problems, to advise on curriculum in other academic institutions and to participate in policy development for national agendas. We also curate secondary data into informative reports that are used extensively by industry and government as reliable source material for their applications and determinations. 4401-
